name: Eugène Louis Boudin

summary.text: Eugène Louis Boudin was one of the first French landscape painters to paint outdoors. Boudin was a marine painter, and expert in the rendering of all that goes upon the sea and along its shores.
summary.title: Eugène Boudin

19913425: Princess Pauline Metternich on the Beach is an oil on cardboard, laid down on wood, painting by French artist Eugène Boudin, from c. 1865-1867.
Princess Pauline Metternich on the Beach
20539471: Venice, Santa Maria della Salute from San Giorgio, is an oil painting by Eugène Louis Boudin, made on his 1895 trip to Venice. It that shows the Basilica di Santa Maria della Salute from the viewpoint of the San Giorgio Maggiore.
Venice, Santa Maria della Salute from San Giorgio
26706274: The Entrance to Trouville Harbour is an 1888 landscape painting by the French artist Eugène Boudin. It features a view of the harbour of the Normandy port of Trouville-sur-Mer.
